What is your return policy?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI

ByRo Bot · AI says:

Our “return policy” is about rentals being sent back on time, in good condition, and how refunds work.

Condition: Items must be returned in the same condition as received: no new damage, permanent stains, or alterations; structurally intact. Normal cleaning is the lender’s job.
Timing: You must post the item back on the last day of your rental using tracked next‑day delivery so it reaches the lender the next working day.
Responsibility in transit: As the renter, you’re responsible for safe return. If it’s lost or damaged in transit, you’re liable and should use insured, tracked postage.
If your item arrives late: Report the issue in‑app on the first rental day and contact the lender. You’re generally entitled to a full refund if you return the item within 24 hours of delivery and don’t use it. Keeping it longer or wearing it usually means only a partial or no refund and you may still be charged late fees if you go past the agreed rental period.
If your item arrives in poor condition or misrepresented: Take photos the day it arrives, message the lender immediately, return it within 24 hours, then submit a refund request through the app.
Refund process:
Report issues by 23:59 on the first rental day (inspection window) and return within 24 hours.
Request the refund from the Rental page; approved refunds go back to your original payment method (rental cost only; service fees are non‑refundable).
For fit issues, refunds (when a lender offers them) are issued as app credit only, not cash, and postage/cleaning fees aren’t refunded.
Late returns: If you send the item back after the last rental day, you may be charged late fees. If you think you’ll be late, you should agree an extension with the lender; they can invoice you for extra days.

In short: return on time, in the same condition, and report any problems on day one with quick return to stay eligible for refunds or credits.
